required_fixes.issue: Canonical-identity dedupe cannot merge source-level twin records: OpenCaseLaw exposes the same judgment under two ids (e.g. bge_BGE_124_III_201 and bge_124 III 201 - both HTTP 200, same decision_date 1998-01-22, same citation_string_de, differing only in docket formatting). 6 such pairs in the primary live bundle (6/300 = 2%), 0 in the secondary bundle, 0 in the 105-candidate fixture replay. Charter acceptance (3) is met literally (dedupe IS deterministic by decision_id/canonical identity), but a downstream map could render twin nodes for one real decision.
required_fixes.fix: Add a normalized (court, decision_date, docket-without-court-prefix, spaces-stripped) identity scheme to canonical_identity_v1, then regenerate LIVE_* evidence for the new run; committed fixtures are unaffected (0 twin pairs) so frozen evaluation inputs remain valid. Do not change fixtures while benchmarks are frozen.

claim_ceiling: OpenCaseLaw retrieval/cache adapter only: deterministic (given identical HTTP responses), provenance-preserving, source-linked query_result_bundle candidate sets of 100-300 decisions from live or cached OpenCaseLaw, with API-supplied canonical_url/citation_string, multilingual server-side de/fr/it language filters plus a closed accepted-lexicon expansion (no machine translation), lazy full-text/structure hydration, bounded citation and leading-case neighbourhood expansion, order-independent dedupe by canonical identity, frozen offline fixtures (19 envelopes, replay 105 candidates), an enforced <=5 req/s soft pace configured at 4.0 rps (a configured ceiling, not measured throughput; measured 0.11-0.45 rps), stdlib-only/no-API-key operation, and a validated machine-readable product bridge with explicit pending_downstream placeholders. NOT delivered and NOT claimed: answer generation, clustering, relations, map layout (x/y), counter-status, UI/clickable-map rendering (product/evaluation lanes, correctly marked incomplete by the producer); any recall/accuracy benchmark (none run; fixtures frozen for eval); merging of source-level twin records exposed by the source under two ids (~2% of one live run); language/title/regeste/snippet for un-hydrated citation-neighbour shells (35/300 in the primary live run - hydrate first, producer reports them honestly as +35 unlabelled); and no dependency on or rebuild of the legacy 174k corpus.
